subject: Multi-stage uplift decision framework
body:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cloudpeak.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-stage uplift decision framework

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership has asked for a short decision framework outlining uplift options so procurement can decide whether to do a small mid-cycle top-up or annualize additional capacity now. Key constraints: PO window closes first week of July, and legal prefers a single SOW if we annualize. Can you share the options matrix and an estimate of near-term pricing impact?

I attached a quick forecast. Happy to jump on a 30-min call.

—Alex
CloudPeak, Head of Platform

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cloudpeak.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-stage uplift decision framework

Alex — thanks for the context and the forecast. Attached is a one-page matrix (CloudPeak_Uplift_Matrix.xlsx) that lays out three defensible options:

1) Fast Top-up (quarterly true-up): immediate 25% capacity top-up, pro-rated invoice, no change to term.
2) Staged Voucher (bridge): two vouchers delivered this FY to cover bursts, invoiced up-front at a 10% discount vs list, bridges to existing term.
3) Annualize Extra (annualize now): increase committed units by 40%, move to a 12-month addendum, and apply an annualized discount tier (15% off list).

I've put estimated unit economics on the right column for each (projected token spend, uplifted unit cost, estimated margin impact). Quick asks from our side before finalizing:
- Confirm expected consumption ramp through Q4 (Alex — your attachment helps but we need weekly cadence).
- Is procurement able to sign an addendum by July 9 if we go with Annualize?
- Any legal constraints around voucher prepayment your counsel flagged?

If it helps, I can propose a mutual action plan and timeline — happy to take the lead. Are you available Thu or Fri this week for a 30-min decision call?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-stage uplift decision framework

Adding the rough pricing numbers that legal/finance want visible in the thread:

- Fast Top-up: list price applied pro-rata; sticker impact ~ +12% ARR burn rate for Q3; minimal contract work.
- Staged Voucher: effective unit price ~ -10% vs list if invoiced up-front; cash collected earlier (improves 2026 cashflow), margin impact neutral to slightly positive after amortization.
- Annualize Extra: 15% discount at scale, requires an addendum and updated SLA cadence; long-term ARR improves and unit economics are best for them, but procurement lead time is the blocker.

Ben — can you confirm whether our legal redline window for an addendum is 5 business days once we hand the SOW? If not, we'll need to plan a one-week buffer.

—Marissa
Director, Sales Ops

---
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cloudpeak.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudpeak.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-stage uplift decision framework

Thanks — this is helpful. Leadership prefers Option 3 (Annualize Extra) if we can get Procurement to commit by the July 9 window. Their rationale: predictable unit pricing and simplified billing for our finance team.

Priya from Procurement: can you confirm expected PO timing? We can aim to trigger the addendum if legal turnaround is within an acceptable buffer. Also, what SLA/uptime reporting cadence do you need?

On vouchers — Procurement is open to a partial voucher top-up as a fallback, but prefer annualize.

—Alex

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cloudpeak.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-stage uplift decision framework

Alex / Priya — great, thanks for the directional preference. Proposed mutual action plan and next steps (timeline assumes legal 5 business-day review):

1) Today: I’ll share a clean SOW addendum draft (SOW_CloudPeak_v2.docx) and the uplift matrix to Procurement and Legal.
2) By Tue 2026-06-29: Procurement confirms PO window and any internal signoffs required.
3) By Fri 2026-07-02: Redwood legal to receive redline; we aim to return counters within 3 business days.
4) By Fri 2026-07-09: Target DocuSign execution and invoice scheduling for annualized commit.

If Procurement needs more time we will provisionally reserve the voucher bridge (staged vouchers) to guarantee capacity for Q3, invoiced up-front at the discounted voucher rate. Either path preserves SLA and routing priorities.

Action items:
- Alex / Priya: confirm PO date and whether AP will accept a single addendum SOW or require separate invoices.
- Marissa / Ben: stand by for any legal redline requests; flag if we need commercial concessions.
- I will prepare the DocuSign packet and perf appendix once we confirm procurement timing.

DocuSign link (preview): https://www.docusign.net/exec?doc=ABC-CP-2026
Attachments: CloudPeak_Uplift_Matrix.xlsx, SOW_CloudPeak_v2.docx

Thanks — I’ll set up a 30-min readout for Fri 9:00am PT to finalize.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
